class.name: AbilitySystemComponent
class.brief_description: Grants and runs gameplay abilities and gives an actor access to its attribute sets.
class.description: Add this component as a child of an actor. Use [method give_ability] to grant a [GameplayAbility] script. Keep its grant handle to start or cancel the ability or remove it from the actor. Select project attribute sets in the component's Inspector. A local component starts each assigned attribute at zero. Actor code can get a set in its Ready callback and supply starting values. A Match component reads its character through [method MatchAttributes.bind_component] and returns null readings while waiting for confirmed values. Use [method get_attribute_set] to work with local IDs inside one set.

method.name: give_ability
method.description: Grants an instantiable [GameplayAbility] script with an [code]on_activated[/code] callback at a positive [param level]. Returns a positive grant handle scoped to this component, or [code]0[/code] if the grant is invalid or unavailable. Use the returned handle for later runs of this grant.

method.name: try_activate_ability
method.description: Tries to start the granted ability. On success a new instance runs its activation callback. Returns [code]OK[/code] when accepted and an error if the grant is unknown, the ability is already running, the actor cannot activate it, or the component lacks authority.

method.name: cancel_ability
method.description: Cancels the active run for [param handle]. Calls the ability's optional [code]on_canceled[/code] callback, followed by [code]on_ended[/code] with [code]canceled = true[/code]. The grant remains available for a future run. Returns [code]OK[/code] when canceled or an error when the grant is unknown, inactive, or unavailable to this caller.

method.name: clear_ability
method.description: Removes the grant for [param handle] and cancels its active run. Returns [code]OK[/code] when removed or an error when the grant is unknown or unavailable to this caller.

method.name: is_ability_active
method.description: Returns whether [param handle] identifies a grant with an active run on this component.

method.name: get_ability_level
method.description: Returns the level assigned when [param handle] was granted, or [code]0[/code] for an unknown grant.

method.name: get_attribute_set
method.description: Returns the live set for an assigned [param set_id], such as [code]main_set[/code]. Returns null before the component enters Ready or if the set is unassigned. You can obtain a configured Match set while its values are still unavailable.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns the detached confirmed reading for a full ID such as [code]main_set.health[/code], or null when unavailable, unassigned, or outside the recipient's visibility.

method.name: set_base
method.description: Replaces the base of the full ID [param attribute_id] with finite [param value], in the attribute's units. Returns [code]OK[/code] on success or a Godot error for a read-only source, unavailable or unknown attribute, invalid input, or rejected commit.

method.name: add_base
method.description: Adds finite [param delta], in the attribute's units, to the base of the full ID [param attribute_id]. Returns [code]OK[/code] on success or a Godot error when the source rejects the edit, the attribute is unavailable, or the result is outside the finite numeric range.

method.name: watch_attribute
method.description: Creates a filtered watch for the full ID [param attribute_id]. Returns null before Ready or when the ID has an unassigned set. Retain the watch to receive committed changes. A Match watch can observe the first confirmed reading.

members.member: The stable IDs of the project sets assigned to this actor. Choose them in the Inspector before the component starts.
Choose Local for independent actor values or Match to bind this actor to coordinated character values. Set the source before the component starts.

constants.constant: Create local values for this actor instance.
Read the coordinated character after binding to its match.
